entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 11/11/2024 This application for bail under Section 483 BNSS has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.296/2024 registered at Police Station Pindwara,
Dist. Sirohi, for the offences under Sections 420, 407 & 120-B of IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that for the alleged incident which occurred on 11.04.2023, the FIR against the present petitioner and co-accused persons has been lodged in the month of August, 2024 that is after a delay of about more than one year.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner are triable by the Court of Magistrate.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody; the investigation against the [2024:RJ-JD:45349] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-11765/2024] present petitioner has already been completed and the challan has already been filed and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 BNSS is allowed.

It is ordered that the petitioner Shambhu Lal S/o Shri Mangilal (Maganlal) arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.296/2024 registered at Police Station Pindwara, Dist. Sirohi, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 40-mohit/-
